name: Sporthotel Reisch
beschreibung:
History

The house appears today as the 4-star hotel Das Reisch, website dasreisch.com. The English homepage still uses the name Sporthotel Reisch. The hotel page writes that one has felt at ease for generations in the centre of Kitzbühel. The accommodation description on kitzbuehel.com, worded in the house’s first person plural, says: “For more than 100 years our house has stood under the sign of particular hospitality.” An exact founding year or a document is not linked by this page. The English hotel line „for centuries“ is a further marketing formula and is not adopted here as a second, longer chronology. What is documented is the self-description as a traditional house that combines modern legend rooms and a rustic guest parlour. The legend rooms are dedicated to Kitzbühel legends or legendary places. The Wunderteam suite on kitzbuehel.com names Toni Sailer, Ernst Hinterseer, Christian Pravda, Fritz Huber, Anderl Molterer and Christian Leitner and the 1950s of the Kitzbühel Wunderteam. That is the dedication of the suite, not a claim that these athletes lived in the house.

Getting there

The address is Franz-Reisch-Straße 3, 6370 Kitzbühel, telephone +43 5356 633660, email info@dasreisch.com. Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. kitzski.at names the Hahnenkammbahn at 200 metres, the Schwarzsee at 2.2 kilometres and Kitzbühel main station at 1.2 kilometres. The hotel’s room page writes that the station Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm lies about 400 metres away and thus a few minutes on foot. The two distance figures for the station contradict each other, depending on which station is meant, and are therefore both named with their source. The hotel page says that ski passes are available at reception and that arrival by public transport is easily possible, without naming a line number. Parking is free according to kitzbuehel.com; a garage space costs 15 euros per day.

Tips

kitzbuehel.com lists 1 single room, 34 double rooms and 78 beds, 24-hour reception, lift, bar, wine cellar, à-la-carte restaurant, breakfast buffet, half board on request, sauna, steam bath, infrared cabin, fitness room, rest area, massage and solarium. Sauna, steam bath, infrared cabin, fitness room and parking are named there as services free of charge. The stay levy is 1.80 euros per person per day and is not included in the price. Prices are per person per day including breakfast buffet. According to the same page, English, Italian and French are spoken. Pets are welcome, for rooms by prior arrangement. Wi-Fi is free of charge. There is a seminar room. After the booking the hotel sends a payment link for the deposit. Cash, credit card and Maestro are indicated.

Room examples on kitzbuehel.com and kitzski.at: double room Legenden about 30 square metres with wooden floor, bathtub or shower, Wi-Fi, minibar and Flat-TV. The first and third floors have been renovated; 16 rooms are dedicated to Kitzbühel legends. The Wunderteam suite measures about 45 square metres. The Kaisersuite measures about 90 square metres, with two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room with an open fireplace and a balcony, on the fourth floor facing north. kitzski.at shows for a double room Legenden a starting price from 264.50 euros per unit per night. The hotel page speaks in one place of rooms or suites from 100 euros per night. The figures come from different pages and dates and are not a guarantee for a specific date.
kurzbeschreibung: 4-star hotel Das Reisch, formerly Sporthotel Reisch, Franz-Reisch-Straße 3 in the centre of Kitzbühel, with legend rooms, restaurant and wellness.
